# Product Lab — Aleksandr Shulgin

> A product storefront offering the Living Mascot canvas engine as a self-service download, two turnkey services (a personal content factory that publishes to five social platforms daily, and an agent harness that makes coding agents remember context and stop breaking things silently), plus fixed-scope sprints (interactive mascots, landing pages, particle case-study sites, promo videos rendered from code, motion polish, site speed, AI-assisted project rescue, Telegram bots, AI chat widgets, workflow automation, AI search visibility, data scraping, dashboards and VPS security). Every sprint has a defined input, output and acceptance check before the price is quoted.

## Products

- [Living Mascot](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/mascot/): A living canvas engine with a flexible theme, recolorable for any brand through a single color config. Reacts to the pointer and clicks, expresses 10 emotions, falls asleep when idle. Canvas 2D, zero runtime dependencies, ESM and plain script builds. $19, personal license, 6.9 KB gzip. Live demo at the link above.
- [Qwerty Switcher](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/#apps): v0.7.0 macOS 13+ subscription app, $6/year with a 14-day free trial, no card required. It locally fixes Russian/English keyboard layouts, converts selected or recently typed text, supports per-app profiles, timed pause, text snippets, smart case and versioned settings backups. Typed text stays on the Mac; license checks send a stable Mac identifier and the app version. The DMG is available on the store page. Self-signed build (right-click → Open on first launch); Apple notarization is in progress.

## Services

- [Content Factory](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/factory/): from $250 setup, from $75/mo support (or run it on your own API keys). A turnkey personal content factory: one topic each morning becomes platform-specific posts for X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky and VK, with generated covers, a built-in critic that rejects weak drafts before publishing, per-platform best-time scheduling and a content strategy that rotates value, warm-up and offer posts. The author's own factory has been running daily since May 2026 with 100+ posts published on autopilot. Demo video and live screenshots on the page. English version: https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/factory/en/
- [Agent Harness](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/agents/): from $290 per project, from $120 for an audit of an existing setup (the audit price counts toward the harness). Setup around coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex: project rules the model actually reads, memory of findings across sessions, gates on irreversible actions (deploy, deletion, money, publishing), verifiable handoff instead of the word "done", your repeatable operations captured as agent procedures, and task routing between heavy and cheap models. All harness files stay in your repository as plain text under git, with no lock-in or subscription.
- Promo Video Sprint: from $89. A 30-60 second promo rendered from code rather than edited by hand: kinetic type, animated figures, product footage, music. Rebuilding with new numbers is one command, not a new order. 16:9 and 9:16.

- Interactive Mascot Sprint: from $49 (launch discount, was $89). Animate an existing character or build a simple code-native one for a hero, onboarding, login or status flow.
- Landing Page Sprint: from $79 (launch discount, was $129). A complete page: offer, structure, visual language, responsive build and deploy.
- Particle Case Sprint: from $119. A cinematic scroll-driven case-study site: a story in five chapters rendered by a 24,000-particle WebGL scene, 60 fps on phones, zero dependencies. Live demo: https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/case-demo/
- Motion Polish Sprint: from $59. Audit and sharpen 5-8 key micro-interactions on an existing site.
- Site Speed Sprint: from $49. Core Web Vitals diagnosis and top fixes, with a Lighthouse report before and after.
- Vibe Code Rescue: from $119 (launch discount, was $199). Take a project built in Cursor, Lovable, Bolt or ChatGPT to production: security audit, error handling, real server deploy.
- Telegram Bot Sprint: from $119. A turnkey bot with conversation logic, notifications, deploy and full code handover.
- AI Chat Widget Sprint: from $89. A chat widget on Claude or GPT trained on your own materials, with a token cost estimate included.
- Workflow Automation Sprint: from $89. Turn one repeated manual process into a testable pipeline, with optional payment and CRM integrations.
- AI Visibility Sprint: from $69. Technical readiness for AI search: llms.txt, JSON-LD, metadata, a machine-readable layer.
- Data Scraping Sprint: from $79. Scheduled data collection from legal, public sources, with code handed over.
- Dashboard Sprint: from $119. A live metrics panel with 1-2 data connections and 4-6 widgets, no monthly BI license.
- VPS Safety Sprint: from $49. Audit of public surface, SSH, firewall, secrets and backups, with verification commands for every fix.

## For Non-Technical Clients

- [Prosto (RU)](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/prosto/): A plain-language services page for non-technical clients: websites, bots, automation and AI assistants explained without jargon. Russian, the primary version. Machine-readable summary: https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/prosto/llms.txt
- [Prosto (EN)](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/prosto/en/): English mirror of the same plain-language services page.

## Open Source

- [Server Hardening Playbook](https://github.com/Sanexxxx777/server-hardening-playbook): A practical failure to fix to verify format for SSH, firewall, service binding, secrets and databases. MIT.
- [PM2 Cockpit](https://github.com/Sanexxxx777/pm2-cockpit): A Telegram control panel for PM2 processes with confirmations, an allowlist and real state verification. MIT.
- [Erdos OpenEvolve](https://github.com/Sanexxxx777/erdos-openevolve): An evolutionary LLM pipeline that reproduced a SOTA result on an Erdos problem, with an independent verify.py.
- [Transaction Guardian](https://github.com/Sanexxxx777/transaction-guardian): A security bot for crypto wallets: transaction monitoring and alerts. MIT.
- [Curated Claude Code](https://github.com/Sanexxxx777/curated-claude-code): A methodology for AI-augmented development: conventions, verification discipline, working patterns.
- MEXC PHP Client: A zero-dependency cURL client, pending a release review before the repository is opened.

- Custom task: any other web, AI or automation job can be requested through the contact form; scope and price are quoted before work starts.
- Payment: card, crypto or transfer, discussed in chat. For sprints up to $100 paying in full on acceptance is an option.
